title: Self Sustaining Identifiers
definition: Unique identifiers that contain complete information, enabling growth and connection in various networks.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of a self-sustaining identifier as a seed. It has all the information it needs to grow into a complex system and connect with others.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Self-sustaining identifiers are akin to CIDs, which use a genetic blueprint-like structure. They are self-describing, future-proof, and compatible across platforms.
difficulty_levels.expert: The novel insight is the metaphor of self-sustaining identifiers as fungal spores. This highlights the interconnectedness and growth potential of these identifiers. It also connects to other fields, such as biology and network theory.

extra_fields.insight: The metaphor of self-sustaining identifiers as fungal spores highlights their interconnectedness and growth potential.
